chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to 'Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, while he was his governor over Basra.
ai.seo_question: Who was the governor of Basra appointed by Imam Ali in this letter?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a seminal administrative letter from Imam Ali (AS) to Abdullah ibn al-Abbas, his governor in Basra, highlighting the Fatimid era's emphasis on just governance and accountability. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the political and spiritual leadership model in Shia tradition, where the Imam’s directives blend divine wisdom with practical statecraft. The correspondence underscores the importance of selecting capable officials and maintaining integrity in public service.
